contents.text: The Seat Cushion
Chemically recycled polyurethane foam from end-of-life vehicle seats provides support and comfort on every stage in the Sonnenwagen seat.
The Back Seat
Mechanically recyclable, breathable, washable - the TPU seat cushion shows how high-tech comfort, and the circular economy can be optimally combined.
The Steering Wheel
A polyurethane-based steering wheel cover ensures aprecise grip. The more sustainable synthetic leather is water-based and contains partially bio-based components.
The Crash Absorber

The front section of the Sonnenwagen contains a polyurethane foam that specifically absorbs energy in the event of an emergency. It deforms under pressure and thus protects the interior of the vehicle.
The Headlamp Cover

Severe weather and stone chips are part of the route in the Australian outback. The headlamps have to withstand this, which is why they are protected by covers made of highly impact-resistant polycarbonate.
The LED Heat Sink
Where metal would be too heavy, a polycarbonate with high thermal conductivity is used. It cools the LED lighting technology in the Sonnenwagen reliably and without conducting electricity.
The Coating
The Sonnenwagen is coated with a high-solids coating that hardens efficiently at room temperature - it saves energy and time, reduces emissions and is based on more sustainable raw materials.
Solar Cell Array
A 6 m² solar cell area maximizes solar energy collection while the vehicle’s optimized aerodynamic shape minimizes drag and improves crosswind stability.
The Battery Damping
Elastomers made from mass-balanced recycled material surround the battery like a protective cushion for full function even under maximum load.
The Battery Cell Holder

A thermally conductive and electrically insulating polycarbonate reduces charging and discharging temperature. It dissipates heat, leads to a more homogeneous temperature distribution, and thus extends the service life.
Steering Rack & Linkage
Transfers the driver’s steering input to the wheels. The redesigned steering system supports larger steering angles and improved maneuverability for the Covestro Æthon.
Instrument Display
Provides the driver with essential vehicle information and real-time system data to support efficient and informed driving.
Rear Suspension Mechanism

The Covestro Æthon features a redesigned suspension and steering system adapted to its increased wheelbase and track width. Larger steering angles improve maneuverability, while integrated sensors measure suspension travel and acceleration to support real-time evaluation and future data-driven improvements.
Shock Absorber

Part of the Covestro Æthon’s adapted suspension system, the shock absorber helps manage wheel movement and supports vehicle stability. The suspension system also integrates sensors to measure suspension travel and acceleration, enabling real-time evaluation and future data-driven improvements.
Tire

The Covestro Æthon features specially developed high-performance tires designed to deliver reliable grip, stability, and durability. The optimized tread pattern provides consistent traction and precise handling, supporting confident performance across a variety of driving conditions.
Mounting Bolt

The Covestro Æthon uses a precision-engineered suspension mounting bolt designed for secure and reliable component assembly. Its robust cylindrical construction and integrated hex socket provide strong structural support, accurate installation, and dependable fastening within the suspension system.
Wheel Rim

The Covestro Æthon features a precision-engineered wheel rim designed to provide a strong and reliable foundation for the tire assembly. Its lightweight ring structure and integrated mounting points support secure wheel installation while maintaining a clean, durable design for efficient vehicle performance.
The Cockpit Canopy
The transparent cockpit canopy is made of impact-resistant polycarbonate. It is lightweight, dimensionally stable, UV-resistant and protects drivers with full visibility and minimal weight.
Suspension & Steering System

The Covestro Æthon features an adapted suspension and steering system with increased wheelbase and track width for improved stability. Larger steering angles and redesigned wheel covers enhance maneuverability, while integrated sensors measure suspension travel and acceleration to support real-time evaluation and future data-driven improvements.
Mounting Bolt

The Covestro Æthon uses a precision-engineered suspension mounting bolt designed for secure and reliable component assembly. Its robust cylindrical construction and integrated hex socket provide strong structural support, accurate installation, and dependable fastening within the suspension system.
Wheel Hub Assembly

The Covestro Æthon features an integrated wheel hub assembly engineered for strength, rigidity, and reliable wheel mounting. Its lightweight structural design combines reinforced spokes, precision-machined mounting surfaces, and an integrated brake disc to provide secure load transfer, efficient braking, and dependable performance under demanding driving conditions.
Mounting Fasteners

The Covestro Æthon uses a precision-engineered suspension mounting bolt designed for secure and reliable component assembly. Its robust cylindrical construction and integrated hex socket provide strong structural support, accurate installation, and dependable fastening within the suspension system.
Retaining Ring

The Covestro Æthon features a precision-machined brake rotor mounting plate designed for secure integration within the wheel and braking assembly. Its lightweight circular structure and strategically positioned mounting tabs provide reliable attachment, structural stability, and accurate alignment for efficient braking performance.
Mounting Bolt

Its robust cylindrical construction and integrated hex socket provide strong structural support, accurate installation, and dependable fastening within the suspension system.
